The '''T'kkrpk''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], long-lived [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]]. They did not begin to calculate time according to the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] until their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] [[Great Reconciliation]] circa [[95 BBY]]; as a result, many of them did not know how old they were. Their language consisted of chittering and clicking noises. Their homeworld was defended by local defense forces, which included a [[Gender/Legends|female]] officer named [[T'Chttrk]].
